picked by: the srgb test author, 2026-10-24. Figures with a source say where it is from.

gamut.source: the sRGB primaries, IEC 61966-2-1, the same as Rec. 709 (recalled)

curve.source: the sRGB curve, IEC 61966-2-1 (recalled). The two pieces differ by 7e-7 of their value at the break, so a tolerance of 1e-8 tells them apart.

slack.about: the slack FromSwatch allows a channel, 1e-4 in linear light, as its doc comment says. The upper bound is 1 plus that, written out so it rounds as the constant does.

dark.about: 1e-12 is the threshold below which a lamp is called dark, from hueAndRange.
